store ingest <csv-path> --dataset <name> --data-version <id> [--db <path>]

Ingest one M1 dataset into the SQLite store.

Options
  --dataset <name>             Dataset name; required.
  --data-version <id>          Caller-supplied identity; required.
  --db <path>                  Database path (default data/db/quantrule.db).

Output
  Prints ingested <name> bars=<n> timeframes=<n>.

Notes
  Input cap: 100000 M1 candles.
  Writes one dataset, every ladder bar, consensus row, Layer 3 row, pivot, level, event, and retained leg in one transaction.
  A same-name dataset with a different identity is a conflict until it is removed.
